findings.summary: The news surfaces ignore the user’s dark color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The desktop screenshot captured with prefers-color-scheme: dark remains a white/light-gray interface, visually matching the default capture.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and map surfaces, text, borders, icons, and embedded content to theme tokens or light-dark().

findings.summary: Animations remain configured when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: The reduced-motion runtime probe still found six 400 ms animations. No evidence showed those non-essential animations being removed or shortened.
findings.suggestedFix: Use @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) to remove non-essential transitions and stop auto-advance.

findings.summary: Several interactive targets are smaller than a comfortable touch target.
findings.evidence: The focus/geometry probe measured subscription buttons at about 46×22 px and article print at 16×17.5 px, despite visible keyboard outlines.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase interactive hit areas to at least 44×44 CSS px while retaining visible :focus-visible styling and non-hover affordances.

findings.summary: Some text and UI colors fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility reported failing color-contrast nodes and an accessibility score of 0.91.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust muted text, border, and control tokens to meet WCAG contrast ratios in every supported theme.

findings.summary: The viewport configuration prevents user zoom.
findings.evidence: The live viewport meta sets maximum-scale=1.0 and user-scalable=no; Lighthouse failed the meta-viewport accessibility audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Use width=device-width, initial-scale=1 and remove maximum-scale, minimum-scale, and user-scalable=no.

findings.summary: Landmark and heading structure is incomplete and the skip link fails accessibility checks.
findings.evidence: The homepage probe found header/footer but no main/nav landmark; the article contains duplicate/empty H1s and uses H2 for its title. Lighthouse reports the skip link is not focusable.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose main/nav landmarks, make the article title the sole meaningful H1, and ensure the skip link becomes visible and focusable and targets an existing focus destination.

findings.summary: Lab loading performance misses the good LCP range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 5.7 s, LCP 6.4 s, and time to interactive 9.3 s. A less-throttled trace measured LCP 1.58 s, so the risk is condition-sensitive but material.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP element and prioritize its request; reduce redirect, render-blocking, and non-critical work before first content.

findings.summary: Redirects and parser-blocking resources add avoidable work to the critical path.
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded two redirects before the final page, parser-inserted blocking CSS and synchronous classic scripts, 114 requests, and 2.16 MB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Link directly to the final canonical URL, defer non-critical classic scripts, and keep only critical CSS/resources in the initial dependency chain.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused CSS and JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 161 KiB unused JavaScript and 100 KiB unused CSS, including news.css at 88% waste and library/read bundles over 60% waste.
findings.suggestedFix: Split bundles by template and interaction, remove unused selectors/modules, and load analytics or optional UI only when needed.

findings.summary: Deprecated unload handling blocks the back/forward cache.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found a deprecated unload listener and four BFCache failure reasons, including UnloadHandlerExistsInMainFrame.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace unload with pagehide/visibilitychange where necessary and remove avoidable no-store/BFCache blockers.

findings.summary: Homepage and article omit meta descriptions.
findings.evidence: Both DOM probes returned description: null; Lighthouse failed meta-description. Titles are descriptive.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit a unique concise meta description for the homepage and each article.

findings.summary: The public news page is blocked from indexing.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed is-crawlable with “Page is blocked from indexing,” despite 100% raw-HTML content coverage and crawlable hrefs.
findings.suggestedFix: Align robots headers/meta and robots.txt with the intended public indexing policy while preserving SSR content.

findings.summary: Canonical signals are absent while the entry URL redirects across hosts.
findings.evidence: Both probes returned canonical: null, and the HAR shows n.news.naver.com → m.news.naver.com → news.naver.com redirects.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish self-consistent canonical URLs per template and make internal links point directly to those URLs.

findings.summary: Article pages provide Open Graph tags but no article structured data.
findings.evidence: The article probe found six Open Graph tags and zero JSON-LD blocks on a page representing a news article.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org NewsArticle JSON-LD matching the visible headline, publisher, author, dates, image, and canonical URL.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS but baseline security headers and cookie protections are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found no CSP or HSTS. Cookie evidence found two cookies without Secure and all six with SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy an enforcing CSP and HSTS, mark HTTPS cookies Secure, and use Lax/Strict SameSite unless cross-site behavior is essential.

findings.summary: Defensive policy coverage is weak and Referrer-Policy is overly permissive.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found no Permissions-Policy or CSP, no HSTS, and Referrer-Policy: unsafe-url; X-Frame-Options and nosniff were present.
findings.suggestedFix: Use strict-origin-when-cross-origin (or stricter), add Permissions-Policy, retain clickjacking/nosniff protection, and deploy CSP/HSTS.

findings.summary: The initial page load has a broad cross-origin analytics/advertising footprint.
findings.evidence: Trackers evidence observed 14 non-host origins; HAR attribution counted 108 cross-origin requests and 2.16 MB, including ad and logging endpoints. No known third-party tracker signature was matched.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory every logging/ad request, remove low-value calls, batch analytics, and defer non-essential collection until contextual consent or interaction.

findings.summary: Image delivery relies heavily on legacy formats and oversized sources.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 98 legacy-format images, no modern-format images, and 23 sources over twice their rendered width.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP variants and select source dimensions close to rendered size while retaining explicit dimensions and lazy loading.

findings.summary: Third-party-style cross-origin assets dominate the page budget.
findings.evidence: The HAR recorded 2.16 MB transferred, with 2.158 MB attributed outside the n.news.naver.com origin and large sprite/analytics/ad resources among the top offenders.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an explicit per-template byte/request budget, consolidate same-company hosts where practical, and defer ads, analytics, and below-fold media.

taskList.title: Restore zoom, contrast, semantic structure, and target sizing
Fix public indexing, canonical, description, and NewsArticle metadata
Deploy CSP/HSTS and safer browser/cookie policies
Reduce critical-path, unused code, and LCP cost
Add preference-driven dark and reduced-motion modes
Modernize image delivery and enforce a cross-origin page budget
